reason: I already order through an agent from Erbil and it has mostly worked fine, so I have no reason to switch to a new name nobody I know has tried. And for the kids' things I need, I can usually find something close in the Baghdad market today without waiting three weeks.
objection: 21,000 IQD in fees on a 30,000 item is a lot of money for me, and you are new, so if something goes wrong I don't know if I will ever see my money again.
would_change_my_mind: If my current service let me down, or a friend or relative showed me their order arrived from Baghdad Express on time with no surprises.
